title: Fairy Tail Zerø
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A one-volume prequel to Fairy Tail about Mavis Vermillion, its future first master. As a six-year-old bookworm she is mistreated as a servant by the Red Lizard guild on Sirius Island until a raid by the Blue Skull guild leaves only Mavis and the master's daughter Zera alive; years later, treasure hunters seeking the island's sacred Tenrou Jade draw Mavis into an adventure that leads toward founding a guild.
life_message: Hope, friendship and imagination can survive cruelty and loss, and grow into a family of one's own choosing.
